description: Source code for the SqlJsonExecutionContext class and related classes/functions used in Superset for managing SQL execution context, including query parameters, database interactions, and query creation.

classes.name: SqlJsonExecutionContext
classes.description: Class managing the context for executing SQL queries, including parameters, database info, and query creation.

classes.name: CreateTableAsSelect
classes.description: Class representing the parameters for creating a table as select (CTAS) operation.

methods.name: set_query
methods.description: Sets the query object for the execution context.

methods.name: _init_from_query_params
methods.description: Initializes the execution context from provided query parameters.

methods.name: _get_template_params
methods.description: Parses and returns template parameters from query parameters.

methods.name: _get_limit_param
methods.description: Determines and validates the query limit parameter.

methods.name: is_run_asynchronous
methods.description: Returns whether the query should run asynchronously.

methods.name: select_as_cta
methods.description: Property indicating if the query is a create-table-as-select operation.

methods.name: set_database
methods.description: Associates a database object with the execution context and sets related parameters.

methods.name: _get_ctas_target_schema_name
methods.description: Determines the target schema name for CTAS operations.

methods.name: get_execution_result
methods.description: Retrieves the stored SQL execution result.

methods.name: create_query
methods.description: Constructs a Query object based on the current context.

methods.name: get_query_details
methods.description: Returns a string with details about the query.
